info.name: Hospigo 7 reports and print templates
info.description: Step 7 (API): the daily collection report (JSON and CSV, one branch and all branches), and print templates. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api  (2) re-run the dev seed so Admin roles get the new report permission: NODE_ENV=development npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api  (3) start the API on port 3000. Select the Hospigo Local environment (staffPassword and superadminPassword). Run collection. About 4 logins count against the login IP limit (20 per minute). The collection makes ONE paid visit and restores the receipt template to the default at the end.

item.name: 1 Daily collection report
4 Report of today BEFORE (SuperAdmin, active branch)

exec: pm.test('a report with today, the time zone and one branch', () => { pm.expect(j.date).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('today')); pm.expect(j.timezone).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.combined).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.branches).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test('collected minus returned is the net', () => pm.expect(j.totals.netPaise).to.eql(j.totals.collectedPaise - j.totals.refundedPaise));

pm.test('by mode, by doctor and by bill type each add up to the total', () => { for (const k of ['byMode','byDoctor','byBillType']) { pm.expect(j[k].reduce((s, r) => s + r.collectedPaise, 0), k).to.eql(j.totals.collectedPaise); pm.expect(j[k].reduce((s, r) => s + r.refundedPaise, 0), k).to.eql(j.totals.refundedPaise); } });
pm.test('the ledger of the day agrees to the paise', () => pm.expect(j.ledger.matches).to.eql(true));
const cash = j.byMode.find(m => m.key === 'CASH'); pm.collectionVariables.set('rBeforeCash', cash ? cash.collectedPaise : 0);

item.name: 5 Receptionist cannot read the report (403)
6 No token = 401
7 Pick Doctor North 2

exec: pm.test('Doctor North 2 is available', () => { pm.expect(d).to.exist; pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 8 Register a patient
9 Reception takes cash for a visit
10 Report AFTER: exactly that money more, one more visit, still agrees with the ledger

exec: pm.test('collected grew by exactly the visit total', () => pm.expect(j.totals.collectedPaise).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rBeforeCollected')) + total));

pm.test('one more payment and one more visit', () => { pm.expect(j.totals.payments).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rBeforePayments')) + 1); pm.expect(j.counts.visits).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rBeforeVisits')) + 1); });
pm.test('the cash line grew by the visit total', () => pm.expect(cash.collectedPaise).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rBeforeCash')) + total));
pm.test('no patient data in the report', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rName')));

item.name: 11 Bad dates are refused (400): not a date, before the product, tomorrow
12 A date before 2020 (400)
13 A day that has not started yet (400)

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('tomorrow', t > today ? t : new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 3600 * 1000).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }));

item.name: 14 A branch id the person may not report on is refused (403)

exec: pm.test('403: not a branch this person may report on (deny by default)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: 15 All branches (hospital-wide SuperAdmin): every branch listed, a row per active branch

exec: pm.test('combined, with every branch of the hospital', () => { pm.expect(j.combined).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.branches.length).to.be.above(1); pm.expect(j.byBranch.length).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(j.byBranch.length).to.be.at.most(j.branches.length); });
pm.test('the branch rows add up to the total', () => pm.expect(j.byBranch.reduce((s, r) => s + r.collectedPaise, 0)).to.eql(j.totals.collectedPaise));

pm.test('combined is at least what this branch collected', () => pm.expect(j.totals.collectedPaise).to.be.at.least(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rBeforeCollected')) + parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('rVisitTotal'))));

item.name: 16 Another hospital: its own branches only, none of ours

exec: pm.test('none of the north branches is in this report', () => { const north = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('rNorthBranchIds')); pm.expect(j.branches.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(j.branches.map(b => b.id).filter(id => north.includes(id))).to.eql([]); });
pm.test('it is its own hospital: combined, ledger agrees', () => { pm.expect(j.combined).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.ledger.matches).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 17 CSV download: a file Excel can open

exec: pm.test('csv type and file name', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.include('collection-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('today') + '.csv'); });

pm.test('starts with the Excel mark and the header row', () => { const raw = pm.response.stream; pm.expect([raw[0], raw[1], raw[2]]).to.eql([0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF]); pm.expect(text).to.include('date,branches,section,key,name,payments,refunds,collected_rupees,refunded_rupees,net_rupees,visits'); });
pm.test('has a TOTAL row and MODE rows', () => { pm.expect(text).to.include(',TOTAL,total,Total,'); pm.expect(text).to.include(',MODE,CASH,'); });
pm.test('no patient data in the file', () => pm.expect(text).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rName')));

item.name: 18 CSV: Receptionist cannot download it (403)
2 Print templates
19 Start clean: back to the default (SuperAdmin)

exec: pm.test('default A5', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.source).to.eql('DEFAULT'); pm.expect(j.paper).to.eql('A5'); });

item.name: 20 Reception can READ the templates (to print)

exec: pm.test('the five documents, and the receipt is back on its built-in default', () => { pm.expect(j.items.map(i => i.docType)).to.eql(['REGISTRATION_SLIP','RECEIPT','PRESCRIPTION','PATIENT_REPORT','PATIENT_CARD']); pm.expect(j.items.find(i => i.docType === 'RECEIPT').source).to.eql('DEFAULT'); });
pm.test('the real page size is given', () => { const r = j.items.find(i => i.docType === 'RECEIPT'); pm.expect(r.pageWidthMm).to.eql(148); pm.expect(r.pageHeightMm).to.eql(210); });
